findings.description: Defaulting the new minimum to 1 changes existing subsecond backoffs and can cause waits to exceed the configured maximum. Default it to 0 to preserve behavior for callers that omit `min`.
findings.rationale: For an existing caller using wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, max=0.5, jitter=0), the first wait previously returned 0.1 seconds. The new default minimum forces every wait to at least 1 second, even though the caller explicitly capped waits at 0.5 seconds, unexpectedly increasing retry latency.
